channel.title: The San Francisco Standard - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The San Francisco Standard (sfstandard.com)

item.title: A luxury listing with a hint of Hogwarts for $14.5M
item.description: The sellers chose a new-build downtown penthouse over continuing with renovation plans on their historic Pac Heights home.

item.title: Garry Tan isn’t leaving California. He’s launching a policy nonprofit instead
item.description: After backing recalls in San Francisco, the Y Combinator chief is taking his political ambitions statewide with a “Rotary Club for radical centrism.”

item.title: The radical act of a sit-down lunch — and the best SF restaurants for a noon reservation
item.description: In defense of the healing properties of a leisurely mid-day meal. Plus: Seven of San Francisco’s best restaurants for a noon reservation.

item.title: The World Cup is coming to the Bay Area, but it will look nothing like the Super Bowl
item.description: After San Francisco hosted buzzy NFL events, San Jose is preparing to seize the spotlight when soccer fans arrive.

item.title: 20 events to celebrate (or rage against) Valentine’s Day in San Francisco
item.description: A “Twilight” rave, queer-friendly craft night, speed dating, a heartbreak party, and more.

item.title: Super Bowl week reminded Tosh Lupoi of what Cal was, and what it should be
item.description: As NFL talent flooded into Berkeley, the new coach put the finishing touches on a transfer class that will shape the program’s future.

item.title: Tech’s pick for governor, Matt Mahan, makes his case for running California
item.description: San Jose Mayor Matt Mahan sits down with “Pacific Standard Time” to explain how his record in the South Bay prepares him for statewide office.

item.title: A popular grocery store chain is opening its first SF location
item.description: Records and sources indicate Sprouts Farmers Market plans to open in a SoMa shopping complex that’s already home to Trader Joe’s.

item.title: On the field and stage, SFUSD kids fill in for striking staff
item.description: Athletes are practicing and theater kids are rehearsing without their coaches and teachers.

item.title: Buster Posey is done shopping and ready to embrace competitions at Giants camp
item.description: Tony Vitello’s team needs young players to step into prominent roles, including Bryce Eldridge, who spent time shagging in the outfield Wednesday.
